title: Product Except Self Basic
constraints: Compute each answer without using division.

examples.explanation: The one zero position receives the product of all non-zero values.
Every product excluding one position still contains at least one zero.

solutionApproaches.title: Multiply Every Other Position
solutionApproaches.complexity: Time O(n²), Space O(1) excluding output
solutionApproaches.explanation: For each result position, multiply all other values; correct but too slow for a large input.

solutionApproaches.title: Prefix and Suffix Products
solutionApproaches.complexity: Time O(n), Space O(1) excluding output
solutionApproaches.explanation: Store left products in the answer, then multiply each by an accumulated right product in a reverse pass.
